title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [LOW/MEDIUM] Fix localStorage setItem unhandled exception DoS
body:
🚨 Severity: LOW/MEDIUM
💡 Vulnerability: `localStorage.setItem` can throw `QuotaExceededError` (if storage is full) or `SecurityError` (if the user disabled third-party cookies). An attacker could intentionally exhaust storage (or the user's environment might be restrictive), causing an unhandled exception when the user attempts to toggle the adblocker. This breaks the UI update and results in a Denial of Service (DoS) of the security tool itself.
🎯 Impact: Toggling the adblocker fails, and the UI falls out of sync, preventing the user from reliably enabling/disabling the blocker.
🔧 Fix: Wrapped `localStorage.setItem` in a `try...catch` block to fail securely, logging the error without exposing stack traces. This ensures the adblocker continues to function in memory even if persistent storage fails.
✅ Verification: Ran `pnpm test` successfully. Added a specific test verifying that mocking `localStorage.setItem` to throw an error does not prevent the toggle UI from updating.
